The '''Taloron language''' was the native [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Taloron]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="AIR" /> who hailed from the [[Taloron system/Legends|Taloron system]].<ref name="CAV2" /> In the language, the word ''Soknar'' meant "several." [[Cene Gilvent]], an [[Ocsin]]in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|martial artist]] and a member of the [[Zulirian Swordmasters]], had a [[Sword/Legends|sword]] named [[Soknar]] for its three blades.<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The language was first mentioned in the sourcebook ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', written by [[Craig Robert Carey|C. Robert Carey]], [[J. P. Pietrzak]], and [[Trevor J. Wilson]] and published by West End Games in [[1995]].<ref name="AIR" />
